items.title: Fee update: lowering and removing DOI registration fees in January 2027
items.summary: We have some rather unusual news to share: Crossref fees are going down again. items.title: Investing $4.9 million of our surplus in rebuilding the Crossref system
items.summary: The infrastructure that registers and distributes Crossref metadata has been running and growing for more than two decades. It now does considerably more than it was built to do, and it shows: two large, tightly coupled monoliths (Content System and REST API), where a change in one place risks breaking something in another. items.summary: TL;DR. Research security screening checks author affiliations against lists of organizations of concern, using bibliometric data.
